post_details: MD really needs a no-perspective, orthographic mode in the 3D viewport. Trying to position things with perspective is imprecise.
post_description: The purpose of this web page is to advocate for the inclusion of a no-perspective, orthographic mode in the 3D viewport of MD to enhance precision in positioning objects.

post_title: Save and Loading a pose Problem
post_details: Hello, I'm currently using MD 9.5 and I'm having an issue that I didn't have in previous versions. When I save a pose. Then use the skeleton to simulate the avatar in a slightly different pose, now when I load the original pose back, I see the skeleton move back to the original bind pose however the avatar itself nor any of the garments move with it. When I click the simulation on and off the avatar "jumps" to the skeletons position in 1 frame and the garment doesn't move with the avatar and there for falls down. I used to be able to use poses to to move the arms around a little to get the kind of folds i wanted, then revert the avatar back to the bind pose by loading in my bind pose. Now this doesn't work anymore :( I really rather not go back to objs and loading avatars as morph target workflow as it's slow and annoying. Anyone has any solutions?
post_description: This webpage aims to provide solutions and troubleshooting tips for users experiencing issues with saving and loading poses in MD 9.5, specifically addressing the synchronization problems between the skeleton and the avatar during simulations.

comments.comment_body: You can go to the menu &gt settings &gt user settings &gt user interface &gt and change the applications screen size and font size..
Yes, but how can anyone follow your recommendation? There is NO SETTINGS in the MENU as you can see in the shot above. I have the same problem and all I have in the top menu is @File@

After digging through internet for 1 or 2 hours I was crying, sorry, and clicking everywhere and somehow when i click at the beginning of label @Hello, PattyPetty@ (nickname) the top menu appears. It doesn't appear regularly - like 1 time of 5-10 clicks. There I pressed Settings and User Settings, then User Interface, and checked out Automatic Scale. It became better and I have my toolbar back on the screen.

post_title: MD 10 - Rotation in 3D window has stopped working.
post_details: Does anyone know why MD 10 suddenly doesn't do rotation with RC and Drag in the 3D window?
post_description: This webpage aims to troubleshoot and provide solutions for the issue of MD 10's 3D window rotation functionality not working with right-click and drag.

comments.comment_body: Check your top toolbar -- settings&gt user settings&gt "View Control" and you will see at the top the PRESET options&gt select the 3-button mouse or regular mouse prese, then close and re open the program. Give that a try.
LOL. That's so obvious when someone points it out. Another facepalm moment! Thank you.
